Brunch Up Sunday — Mynt, Taj West End, Bengaluru (2018).

A weekend F&B campaign dressed several ways: a flat-illustrated food spread, an overhead photographic table, a bright "Sunny Side Sundays" mark, and a "Super Sunday" stack — one offer, many moods, for the season.

F&B campaign design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·42.
